title: First boot: camera fit captured while view.world_w=0 — map renders displaced half a screen with no self-correction
evidence:
app/main.odin:260-272:
	start_run(&app, 42)

	// the view (camera-fit); recomputed on resize
	...
	rnd.view_compute(&app.view, WIN_W, WIN_H, &cat.balance)

app/main.odin:575-578 (inside start_run):
	camera_set_fit(app)
	app.cam_zoom = app.cam_zoom_to
	app.cam_wx = app.cam_wx_to
	app.cam_wy = app.cam_wy_to

app/main.odin:1112-1116:
camera_set_fit :: proc(app: ^App) {
	app.cam_wx_to = app.view.world_w / 2
	app.cam_wy_to = app.view.world_h / 2
	app.cam_zoom_to = 1.0
}

app/main.odin:1191-1194 (camera_update, every frame):
	fit := min(f32(v.win_w)/v.world_w, f32(v.win_h)/v.world_h)
	v.scale = fit * app.cam_zoom
	v.off_x = f32(v.win_w)/2 - app.cam_wx * v.scale
	v.off_y = f32(v.win_h)/2 - app.cam_wy * v.scale

app: App is zero-initialized (app/main.odin:210 "app: App"), so at the start_run call view.world_w/world_h are 0.
detail: start_run runs before the first view_compute, so camera_set_fit snapshots world center (0,0). camera_update then pins the world origin to screen center every frame — first boot shows the map displaced half a screen; nothing re-fits until a selection changes.
recommended_fix: After the first view_compute in main() (or on first camera_update), re-run camera_set_fit and snap cam_wx/cam_wy/cam_zoom — or move start_run's camera snap below the view_compute call.

title: Alerts-as-nav zoom with no prior selection has no exit path — camera stays zoomed after empty-ground click or ESC
detail: Banner click with nothing selected zooms 2.6x via camera_focus_pair, but re-fit only fires on a selection CHANGE; empty-ground press or ESC when sel is already -1 produces no diff — the zoomed camera has no exit.
recommended_fix: Reset to fit on any deselect press (empty ground/ESC) regardless of selection diff — e.g., a cam-focus flag set by camera_focus_pair and cleared by ground/ESC presses calling camera_set_fit.

title: Doorstep fan wraps at 15 slots while one bundle can queue 18 — packets stack at identical pixels under saturation
detail: Fan provides 5x3=15 slots keyed by packet id; one bundle queues up to 3 lanes x 6 = 18 packets, and multiple departing bundles plus at-node packets share one node's fan — past 15, ids collide and packets draw at identical pixels, hiding queue depth during saturation.
recommended_fix: Drop the %3 wrap (derive ky from id/5 unbounded, or count per-node pile depth) so overflow rows extend downward instead of stacking exactly.

title: sprites_load partial failure leaks already-loaded textures; both call sites ignore the returned bool
detail: A mid-sheet failure breaks without unloading textures[0..i-1]; both call sites discard the bool — a partial-failure run silently falls back to primitives with GPU textures left loaded and no diagnostic.
recommended_fix: Unload sh.textures[0..i] before returning false from the break path; log the fallback at the call sites.
